products.name: Pokémon Scarlet & Violet 熱風のアリーナ Booster BOX
products.notes: Official Pokemon product page specifies 5 cards per booster and 2025-03-14. Same manufacturer product campaign specifies purchase of one BOX equals 30 packs. JPY 180 is price per PACK, not BOX MSRP. Campaign gifts are not guaranteed BOX-inserted HITs.

products.name: ONE PIECE 受け継がれる意志 [OP-13] Booster BOX
products.notes: Official ONE PIECE TCG 2025 event merchandise specifies 1 BOX 24 packs, 6 cards per pack; Bandai's own product catalog confirms 2025-08-23 release. Event price JPY 5,280 is a sale offer, not automatically MSRP, transaction price or live stock. Card number OP-13 must not be confused with promo giveaway.
